Full job description
At Accenture Federal Services, nothing matters more than helping the US federal government make the nation stronger and safer and life better for people. Our 13,000+ people are united in a shared purpose to pursue the limitless potential of technology and ingenuity for clients across defense, national security, public safety, civilian, and military health organizations.
Join Accenture Federal Services, a technology company within global Accenture. Recognized as a Glassdoor Top 100 Best Place to Work, we offer a collaborative and caring community where you feel like you belong and are empowered to grow, learn and thrive through hands-on experience, certifications, industry training and more.
Join us to drive positive, lasting change that moves missions and the government forward!



The work:

As a Verification Engineer, you will play a pivotal role in supporting human-level validations that stem from Gen-AI led test-driven design processes. Your primary responsibility will be to ensure that outputs generated by artificial intelligence are thoroughly evaluated and consistently align with established system expectations. You will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to identify discrepancies, analyze AI-generated results, and develop robust validation strategies that uphold the integrity of the system. This position requires a keen attention to detail as you will be tasked with designing and executing comprehensive test cases that challenge both the AI and the underlying system logic. To excel in this role, familiarity with advanced validation frameworks, automated testing tools, and AI model evaluation platforms will be highly advantageous. Experience test-driven development methodologies, version control systems, and continuous integration pipelines will further support your success. Exposure to collaborative tools for tracking issues and documenting validation outcomes will help streamline your workflow. Additionally, a background in analyzing complex data sets, troubleshooting system behaviors, and refining AI outputs based on real-world feedback will position you to make a significant impact in this dynamic environment.

Responsibilities:

Support human-level validations for Gen-AI led test driven design processes
Ensure AI-generated outputs consistently align with system expectations
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to refine and validate AI-driven solutions
Identify and report discrepancies between AI outputs and desired system behaviors
Contribute to the continuous improvement of verification methodologies and tools

Eligibility Requirements:

US Citizenship required
